executiveSummary: Recent tech news highlights AI advancements, hardware releases, and industry shifts, with companies like Apple, Google, and Amazon leading the way. The industry is also seeing supply chain issues and pricing changes, with a focus on sustainable energy and AI-powered innovations.

takeaways.title: AI advancements
takeaways.description: Apple's new AI Health Study aims to improve the effectiveness of AI health tools, while Google's AI trip-planning feature uses machine learning to create custom itineraries.

takeaways.title: Hardware releases
takeaways.description: Apple Watch SE 3 Black Friday deals offer discounts on the Apple Watch SE 3, while the iPhone 20 Pro is rumored to feature a new 17nm camera sensor and a more pronounced curvature design.

takeaways.title: Industry shifts
takeaways.description: The industry is seeing a shift towards sustainable energy, with companies like Mazama Energy developing new geothermal drilling solutions and Bedrock Energy raising $24M to build more AI-enabled geothermal drill rigs.

worthWatching: Amazon's Zoox robotaxis are now available via Uber, marking the first time the two companies have partnered on a robotaxi service.
engineeringPerspective: The use of AI in geothermal drilling solutions can improve efficiency and reduce costs, making it an attractive option for companies looking to invest in sustainable energy.
The development of AI-powered trip-planning features can help improve the user experience in various industries, from transportation to healthcare.
